propositions: A new glob-triggered advisory code-review overlay surfaces divergences in write-op parameters, guards, or required fields when changed on one adapter (lib/_lib_writes.py, CLI/_commands/, MCP/_mcp_writes.py) but not mirrored lockstep across siblings.
The overlay fires only on diffs touching known write-surface adapter files and is wired into round_a and round_b batches of the four-pass code-review gate so the finder is actually dispatched.

The overlay is advisory (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) and carries false-positive guards for deliberate justified divergences, adapter-bound non-caller-visible params, and internal-only refactors.

Registry changes include adding "surface-parity" to OVERLAY_IDS, a routing entry in criteria_routing.json, a bullet in code-review-base.md catalog, and dispatcher entries in code-review.yaml (round_a and round_b).
